function add_one(x integer).sql:
-- FUNCTION: public.add_one(integer)

-- DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.add_one(integer);

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.add_one(
	x integer)
    RETURNS integer
    LANGUAGE 'sql'
    COST 100
    IMMUTABLE PARALLEL UNSAFE
AS $BODY$
SELECT x + 1
$BODY$;

ALTER FUNCTION public.add_one(integer)
    OWNER TO postgres;

table customers.sql:
-- Table: public.customers

-- DROP TABLE IF EXISTS public.customers;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.customers
(
    id serial NOT NULL,
    name character varying(100) COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL,
    email text COLLATE pg_catalog."default",
    mood mood,
    born date,
    score numeric(10,2) DEFAULT 0,
    active boolean DEFAULT true,
    created timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now(),
    CONSTRAINT customers_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
    CONSTRAINT customers_email_key UNIQUE (email)
)

TABLESPACE pg_default;

ALTER TABLE IF EXISTS public.customers
    OWNER to postgres;

COMMENT ON TABLE public.customers
    IS 'people who buy';

COMMENT ON COLUMN public.customers.email
    IS 'contact address';
-- Index: customers_lower_email_idx

-- DROP INDEX IF EXISTS public.customers_lower_email_idx;

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS customers_lower_email_idx
    ON public.customers USING btree
    (lower(email) COLLATE pg_catalog."default" ASC NULLS LAST)
;
-- Index: customers_name_idx

-- DROP INDEX IF EXISTS public.customers_name_idx;

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS customers_name_idx
    ON public.customers USING btree
    (name COLLATE pg_catalog."default" ASC NULLS LAST)
;

table items.sql:

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.items
(
    sku character(8) COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL,
    title text COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL,
    qty integer,
    price double precision,
    tags text[] COLLATE pg_catalog."default",
    meta json,
    weight real,
    added timestamp without time zone,
    ready time without time zone,
    shelf_life interval,
    uid uuid,
    blob bytea,
    small smallint,
    big bigint,
    CONSTRAINT items_pkey PRIMARY KEY (sku),
    CONSTRAINT items_qty_check CHECK (qty > 0)
)

TABLESPACE pg_default;

ALTER TABLE IF EXISTS public.items
    OWNER to postgres;

table order_lines.sql:
-- Table: public.order_lines

-- DROP TABLE IF EXISTS public.order_lines;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.order_lines
(
    order_id bigint NOT NULL,
    line smallint NOT NULL,
    qty integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    total numeric(12,2) GENERATED ALWAYS AS (((qty)::numeric * 2.5)) STORED,
    CONSTRAINT order_lines_pkey PRIMARY KEY (order_id, line),
    CONSTRAINT order_lines_order_id_qty_key UNIQUE (order_id, qty),
    CONSTRAINT order_lines_order_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (order_id)
        REFERENCES public.orders (id) MATCH SIMPLE
        ON UPDATE NO ACTION
        ON DELETE NO ACTION
)

TABLESPACE pg_default;

ALTER TABLE IF EXISTS public.order_lines
    OWNER to postgres;

table orders.sql:
-- Table: public.orders

-- DROP TABLE IF EXISTS public.orders;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.orders
(
    id bigserial NOT NULL,
    customer_id integer NOT NULL,
    sku character(8) COLLATE pg_catalog."default",
    placed date NOT NULL,
    note text COLLATE pg_catalog."default",
    CONSTRAINT orders_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
    CONSTRAINT orders_customer_fk FOREIGN KEY (customer_id)
        REFERENCES public.customers (id) MATCH SIMPLE
        ON UPDATE NO ACTION
        ON DELETE NO ACTION,
    CONSTRAINT orders_sku_fk FOREIGN KEY (sku)
        REFERENCES public.items (sku) MATCH SIMPLE
        ON UPDATE NO ACTION
        ON DELETE NO ACTION,
    CONSTRAINT orders_note_len CHECK (length(note) < 500)
)

TABLESPACE pg_default;

ALTER TABLE IF EXISTS public.orders
    OWNER to postgres;
-- Index: orders_partial_idx

-- DROP INDEX IF EXISTS public.orders_partial_idx;

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS orders_partial_idx
    ON public.orders USING btree
    (customer_id ASC NULLS LAST)

    WHERE note IS NOT NULL;
-- Index: orders_placed_desc_idx

-- DROP INDEX IF EXISTS public.orders_placed_desc_idx;

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS orders_placed_desc_idx
    ON public.orders USING btree
    (placed DESC NULLS FIRST, id ASC NULLS LAST)
;

  GROUP BY c.name;
